content: As of 2026-09-02 PyPI: FastAPI latest stable is 0.141.1 (requires Python>=3.10, deps starlette>=0.46.0, pydantic>=2.9.0, typing-extensions>=4.8.0). Machine-verified baseline: fastapi 0.115.14 + starlette 0.46.2 + pydantic 2.13.4 runs on Python 3.13.1 (health endpoint + APIKeyHeader + TestClient smoke-tested OK). Both 0.115.x and 0.141.x satisfy the needs of a tiny health/state/trigger API; floor recommendation >=0.115.14.
